neighborhoods.name: Jorge Teixeira · Manaus / AM
neighborhoods.scene: Manaus eastern outskirts in the Jorge Teixeira neighborhood, low-rise colorful masonry homes climbing gently up a hill, humid lush Amazonian vegetation between lots, simple açaí shop and neighborhood groceries, covered community football court in background, irregular dense overhead cables, tropical downpour just ended, amber dusk with deep turquoise shadows. No river waterfront or opera house: this is the eastern residential periphery.
neighborhoods.wardrobe: Eastern Manaus on a hot humid tropical evening: character 1 brown-skinned adult man in a lightweight open short-sleeve patterned shirt, bermuda shorts and rubber flip-flops; character 2 slim brown-skinned adult woman in breathable sleeveless shirt, running shorts and worn sneakers; character 3 stocky adult man shirtless in knee-length shorts and sandals; character 4 older adult man light cotton T-shirt, shorts and canvas slip-on shoes. Contemporary Amazonian city clothing, no fantasy Indigenous headdresses, no jungle costumes.

neighborhoods.name: Bom Jardim · Fortaleza / CE
neighborhoods.scene: Bom Jardim neighborhood in inland western Fortaleza, a sunny northeastern suburban commercial street at late golden hour, low colorful single and two story plaster homes, rectangular modern community cultural-center facade inspired by Centro Cultural Bom Jardim in background, painted community art walls, a modest neighborhood football court, warm dry weather, overhead utility wires. No beach or coastal cliffs.
neighborhoods.wardrobe: Bom Jardim in Fortaleza in hot late afternoon: character1 adult man in lightweight cotton football-style T-shirt without logos, bermuda shorts, flip-flops; character2 young adult woman in simple athletic tank top, shorts and sneakers; character3 stocky adult man sleeveless faded work shirt, shorts and worn sandals; character4 adult woman curly hair in light short-sleeve blouse, practical loose trousers and flat sandals. No leather jackets, no cowboy costumes, no beach props.

neighborhoods.name: Pernambués · Salvador / BA
neighborhoods.scene: Pernambués in Salvador: dense hillside self-built red brick and bright pastel masonry houses, narrow stairways climbing BETWEEN buildings in upper half, water tanks and rooftop clotheslines, neighborhood shops at street level, a distant modern elevated metro viaduct reference near Avenida Paralela, purple dusk and rich amber street lamps. Do not depict Pelourinho, beach or postcard historic center.
neighborhoods.wardrobe: Pernambués in Salvador on a hot humid evening: character1 Black adult man shirtless, patterned bermuda shorts and rubber flip-flops; character2 slim Black adult woman in plain sleeveless cotton top, shorts and sneakers; character3 stocky brown-skinned adult man in open lightweight short-sleeve shirt, long shorts, sandals; character4 adult Black woman in loose lightweight T-shirt, breathable trousers and flat sandals. Urban everyday clothing; no ceremonial religious garments, no tourist costumes.

neighborhoods.name: Valéria · Salvador / BA
neighborhoods.scene: Valéria neighborhood on Salvador outer urban edge near the BR-324 corridor, distinctly different from central hills: broad suburban street, modest low masonry and exposed brick houses, a small mechanic repair shop with roller shutter, roadside warehouse roof, a distant highway concrete overpass and wooded hillside; a local community mural with abstract blue and ochre flowers. Late sunset rust orange and dark cobalt blue, light dry road dust.
neighborhoods.wardrobe: Valéria outer Salvador on a warm evening near repair workshops: character1 adult brown-skinned man lightweight short-sleeve work shirt, faded bermuda shorts and sandals; character2 slim adult woman faded cotton tank top, knee-length shorts and lightweight canvas shoes; character3 stocky brown-skinned mechanic man with overalls tied at waist, sleeveless top and protective work boots; character4 older adult woman in simple breathable blue short-sleeve work shirt, loose trousers and practical flat shoes. Shop-worker and neighborhood everyday clothing; avoid heavy winter jackets.

neighborhoods.name: Sol Nascente · Brasília / DF
neighborhoods.scene: Sol Nascente settlement on western outskirts of Brasília, a broad level street, patchwork low one and two story exposed red brick houses, blue household rooftop water tanks, simple neighborhood shops, utility poles, a few unpaved side lots with red Cerrado earth, distant low Cerrado vegetation and wide dramatic sky, violet evening and amber shop lights. NO cathedral, NO Congress building, NO monumental axis: this is the actual residential outskirts.
neighborhoods.wardrobe: Sol Nascente in Distrito Federal at warm dry sunset: character1 adult brown-skinned man lightweight T-shirt, bermuda shorts and rubber flip-flops; character2 slim adult woman cotton T-shirt, light joggers and running sneakers; character3 stocky adult man short-sleeve work shirt, jeans and dusty work boots appropriate to red Cerrado earth; character4 older adult woman light cardigan over T-shirt, loose cotton trousers and flat sandals for cooling evening. No cowboy, gaucho, desert or jungle costumes.

neighborhoods.name: Restinga · Porto Alegre / RS
neighborhoods.scene: Restinga neighborhood in southern Porto Alegre, a wide residential commercial street inspired by Esplanada da Restinga, low brick and plaster homes, broad samba-rehearsal community hall facade, tasteful red green white decorations and abstract swan mural referencing local carnival culture, southern Brazilian vegetation and low hills in distance, cold mist after rain, silver blue night and warm orange storefronts. NO Rio favelas, no beaches, no snowy mountains.
neighborhoods.wardrobe: Restinga in Porto Alegre on a chilly damp southern Brazilian night: character1 brown-skinned adult man in a zip-up hoodie, jeans and sneakers; character2 slim adult woman in light windbreaker over T-shirt, dark joggers and running sneakers; character3 stocky adult man denim jacket over sweatshirt, trousers and boots; character4 older adult woman with gray hair in practical dark lightweight quilted jacket, scarf and closed shoes. Contemporary mixed urban people; no traditional gaucho costumes, no snow gear.

neighborhoods.name: Complexo do Alemão · Rio de Janeiro / RJ
neighborhoods.scene: Complexo do Alemão in northern Rio de Janeiro, dense recognizable red brick hillside self-built favela housing, blue water tanks and rooflines, a cable-car support tower and suspended cable line as a visual reference to the local teleférico infrastructure (not a claim it is operating), a broad flat neighborhood shop street at foot of hill for play area, electrical cables, modest colorful shops, moody indigo midnight and dramatic amber highlights. NO Christ statue, NO Sugarloaf, NO Copacabana.
neighborhoods.wardrobe: Complexo do Alemão in Rio de Janeiro on a hot summer night, local casual clothing diverse rather than uniform: character1 brown-skinned adult man SHIRTLESS, patterned bermuda shorts, rubber FLIP-FLOPS; character2 slim adult Black man in simple tank top, football-style shorts without logos, BAREFOOT; character3 stocky adult brown-skinned man SHIRTLESS, denim knee-length shorts, rubber FLIP-FLOPS; character4 adult Black woman in a loose lightweight sleeveless cotton top, practical shorts and rubber flat sandals. Unarmed ordinary street rivals with raised fists, no face masks, no gun belts, no leather jackets, no boots. Clearly visible bare feet or sandals on all four figures.
